workingPapers.title: Energy Transition, Green Growth, and Public Attention
workingPapers.abstract: A planned empirical study currently limited to literature review, data assembly, and measurement design. No estimated result, completed manuscript, or submission is claimed.

workingPapers.title: Inventory Buffers under Firm-Level Operating and Input-Cost Shocks
workingPapers.abstract: An ongoing firm-level study of how inventory buffers adjust to operating conditions and external input-cost shocks. Existing exploratory outputs are being used to refine exposure measurement, placebo design, and the empirical specification; no completed mechanism or causal finding is claimed.
